With the provided spatula, place foundation on five key areas: forehead, nose, chin, and both cheeks.

title: FOR M·A·C - MATTE FOUNDATION STUDIO FIX FLUID SPF 15 - original 30ml
detail_text: Studio Fix Fluid SPF 15 24HR Matte Foundation + Oil Control Our original matte has been remastered.
